flowerGeometry._comment: Shared FLOWER part geometry in a local frame. Four identical FLOWERs. Loaders ignore this object. namedPoses place this frame on the field (x, y, yaw). Height lives here, not on each pose.
flowerGeometry.localFrame: Origin at the top-opening center in XY. +Z up. +Y out the opening into the FIELD. +X right-handed. Units inches.
flowerGeometry.manualCitation: Competition Manual V1 section 9.7 and Figure 9-12: top opening ~4 in / 4.0 in dia, 21.5 in above TILES; backstop 1.25 in; retrieval opening 3.55 in tall x 3.57 in deep.

pipes.label: Flower HIPS Pipe
pipes.citation: Onshape Field CAD Version 1 / FIRST Field CAD STEP BIOBUZZ_Full Field.20260912.step (Playing Field hub, 12 Sep 2026). Solid am-5862: Flower HIPS Pipe: CYLINDRICAL_SURFACE radii 0.013335 m and 0.010795 m (1.05 in OD, 0.85 in ID, 0.10 in wall). Sixteen instances (four FLOWERs x four pipes) form a 3.45 in x 3.45 in square of vertical axes; wall-parallel pair spacing and front-to-back depth are both 3.45 in. COLOUR_RGB 0.372549, 0.654902, 0.239216 (~95,167,61). Assembly Guide 5.4/5.5: two field-side (front) pipes and two wall-side (back) pipes. HSV not field-tuned; do not treat CAD green as a detector spec.

namedPoses.label: FLOWER on the audience-side perimeter wall
namedPoses.citation: XY and yaw from FIRST Field CAD STEP BIOBUZZ_Full Field.20260912.step, mapped to FTC frame (origin field center, +X right from audience, +Y toward opposite audience, +Z up). STEP Y-up: FTC X=STEP X, FTC Y=STEP Z, FTC Z=STEP Y. Audience is the STEP -Z wall (Red Cell Audience at STEP X<0, Blue Cell Audience at STEP X>0; manual section 9.5 red is left from audience). Pose origin is the 3.45 in pipe-square centroid (top-opening center in plan). Yaw 90 deg = opening faces +Y (into the FIELD). Height is flowerGeometry.topOpeningHeight (21.5 in), not this pose. Setup Guide 10.4 figure is mid-wall with no inches; CAD is 23.3926 in from the wall midpoint toward red. Keep both.

namedPoses.label: FLOWER on the perimeter wall opposite the audience (scoring side)
namedPoses.citation: Same STEP mapping as flower_audience. Pipe-square centroid. Yaw -90 deg = opening faces -Y (into the FIELD). CAD is 23.3926 in from the wall midpoint toward blue.

namedPoses.label: FLOWER on the red (left-from-audience) perimeter wall
namedPoses.citation: Same STEP mapping as flower_audience. Red wall is FTC -X (left from audience, section 9.5). Pipe-square centroid. Yaw 0 deg = opening faces +X (into the FIELD). CAD is 23.3926 in from the wall midpoint toward opposite audience.

namedPoses.label: FLOWER on the blue (right-from-audience) perimeter wall
namedPoses.citation: Same STEP mapping as flower_audience. Blue wall is FTC +X (right from audience). Pipe-square centroid. Yaw 180 deg = opening faces -X (into the FIELD). CAD is 23.3926 in from the wall midpoint toward audience.

namedPoses.label: HIVE Structure frame at field center (pivot axis height)
namedPoses.citation: Located in the center of the FIELD: BIOBUZZ Competition Manual V1 section 9.6. Pivot axis 43.95 in (111.65 cm) above the TILES: section 9.6.1. Frame 49.46 in wide x 38.95 in deep at base (same section). CELLs approximately 18.8 in apart: section 9.6.2. Yaw omitted (not a stated heading in the manual). If Onshape Field CAD V1 disagrees with x=0,y=0 as the frame origin, record both; CAD was not measured here.

elements.label: Red nectar
elements._comment: HSV is a starting point from this file's red plate primary range (h 0-12). Element specs do not load hsvWrap (plates only), so the plate wrap band 168-179 is omitted rather than dead config. Tune on field. Diameter 3.6 in from BIOBUZZ Competition Manual V1 section 9.8 (am-5852_red). Detector/filters copied from POLLEN as a starting point (no new detector in #77).
